rules.instruction: Model classes: ApprovalLetter, CheckingAccount, CreditHistory, Loan, LoanAccount, LoanAgreement, LoanRequest, LoanTerm. Enumeration types: LoanAccountStatus, LoanRequestStatus, LoanStatus, Status. Preserve these model names exactly. Typed local helper and iterator names may be introduced; they are not new model elements.

Loan.BelongedLoanAccount: LoanAccount. This is a single-valued navigation. Navigate as an object; link assignment or clearing requires an explicit requirement. The declaration alone does not require creation, deletion, inverse updates, or a nonempty value.

LoanAccountStatus: use only LoanAccountStatus::HASPAIDINFULL, LoanAccountStatus::NORMAL. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.

LoanRequestStatus: use only LoanRequestStatus::APPROVED, LoanRequestStatus::INCOMPLETEINFORMATION, LoanRequestStatus::READYFORREVIEW, LoanRequestStatus::REFERENCESVALIDATED, LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
LoanStatus: use only LoanStatus::CLOSED, LoanStatus::LSOPEN. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Status: use only Status::GOODSTANDING, Status::SUSPENDED. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Service state self.CurrentApprovalLetter: ApprovalLetter. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.CurrentLoanAgreement: LoanAgreement. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.CurrentLoanRequest: LoanRequest. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.CurrentLoanRequests: Set(LoanRequest). Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
The operation returns Boolean. Use result only in the postcondition, with a compatible value satisfying the stated return obligation; do not assume a Boolean result is true.
